newsitem.title: USA: Hitachi to make handheld personal computer.
newsitem.headline: Hitachi to make handheld personal computer.

text.p: Hitachi Ltd today announced it will manufacture and market a handheld personal computer, or HPC, using Microsoft Corp's Windows CE operating system.
Microsoft's Windows CE system is a platform for a broad range of communications, entertainment, mobile computing devices and other non-desktop PC items.
Hitachi said that the new product will be marketed and sold by its Georgia-based Hitachi Home Electronics unit, but the firm did not set a price or delivery date for the device.

In a statement, Etsuhiko Shoyama, senior executive at Hitachi said, "The Hitachi HPCs will be designed for convenience and simplicity, including features such as long battery life, built-in communications and compatibility with Windows."
